# Ignition: a beautiful error page for Laravel apps

[![Latest Version on Packagist](https://example.invalid/packagist/v/facade/ignition.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/packages/facade/ignition)
![GitHub Workflow Status](https://example.invalid/github/workflow/status/facade/ignition/run-php-tests?label=Tests)
[![Quality Score](https://example.invalid/scrutinizer/g/facade/ignition.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/g/facade/ignition)
[![StyleCI](https://example.invalid/repos/204472210/shield?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/repos/204472210)
[![Total Downloads](https://example.invalid/packagist/dt/facade/ignition.svg?style=flat-square)](https://example.invalid/packages/facade/ignition)

[Ignition](https://example.invalid/docs/ignition-for-laravel/introduction) is a beautiful and customizable error page for Laravel applications running on Laravel 5.5 and newer. It is the default error page for all Laravel 6 applications. It also allows to publicly share your errors on [Flare](https://example.invalid). If configured with a valid Flare API key, your errors in production applications will be tracked, and you'll get notified when they happen.

![Screenshot of ignition](https://example.invalid/ignition/screenshot.png)

## Official Documentation

The official documentation for Ignition can be found on the [Flare website](https://example.invalid/docs/ignition-for-laravel/installation).
